game_title: Safe Get Scout – Supply Cache Camp Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round, ice hawks strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from ice hawks in Supply Cache Camp: keep the safe_lookups meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: safe_lookups drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
